blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippine Competition Commission (PCC) has filed administrative charges against six firms and their officers, which it said were behind the “onion cartel” that drove onion prices to as much as P800 per kilogram in late 2022. Named in the charges were Golden Shine International Freight Forwarders Corp., Tian Long Corp., La Reina Fresh Vegetables & Young Indoor Plants Inc., Yom Trading Corp., and sole proprietors Mark Castro Ocampo and Nancy Collanta Rosal.
